.github/workflows/pages.yml: the file defines or carries out the workflow and its gate

the independent review classified the impact on the architecture as major: The feature changes two protected workflows. .github/workflows/ci.yml now installs the documentation dependencies and Playwright Chromium before ./scripts/verify.sh --all, uploads documentation/reports/ as an artifact, and writes a step summary. .github/workflows/pages.yml installs Chromium before ./check.sh --build. The feature also adds a new kind of dependency to the shared verification path: a headless browser plus axe-core, run by documentation/check.sh --build through the existing 'documentation' check in scripts/verify.conf. That is build and verification infrastructure, which makes it major. It does not contradict an accepted decision: verify.conf, the review gates and the policies under .agents/ are unchanged. The Astro static build and the Pages deployment through configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact and deploy-pages stay as they were. The workflow-map, Docs-layout and documentation edits stay inside the site.
